results.text: The effect of dapagliflozin on renal function in patients with type 2 diabetes. Dapagliflozin's antihyperglycemic effects are mediated by inhibition of renal sodium-glucose cotransporter-2; therefore, renal safety of dapagliflozin was assessed.
